mainFindings: Six tests deliberately create and write isolated temp SQLite databases and set DATABASE_PATH before dynamic DB imports.
An early preloader importing config/db can cache the default/preloader database path before those assignments; do not use that shape for the offline diagnostic.
Physical HTTP-shaped tests replace fetch/client or inject fetchers; configured .invalid/loopback endpoints are not contacted in the current test paths.
provider-accounting.test.ts directly writes accounting/cutover tables in its temp database; it is the strongest DB mutation case.
No executable skip/todo/only markers were found.
